## Definition
A neuromorphic computing substrate where quantum dynamics serve as the reservoir, mapping input signals into high-dimensional feature spaces for temporal processing. It leverages quantum superposition and entanglement to enhance computational capacity beyond classical reservoirs, critical for next-gen in-network neuromorphic processing.
